open_claims.claim: ETH is false (OpenAI and Anthropic)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked; both developments independently replayed (Toledo, kernel + nanoda), machine-model translation informal; review group (Impagliazzo, Paturi, Williams) running a discussion blog, not endorsing; simpler proofs by Kintali and O'Donnell; Fortnow: safe to assume (opinion); as of 2026-11-09 blog collecting Lean replications (Zane) and consequences (Paturi, 1 Nov), still no verdict; 12 Nov: blog posted OpenAI's prompt (asked for refutation of deterministic SETH with specific target); still no verdict as of 2026-11-16; no new blog posts and no verdict as of 2026-11-23
open_claims.watch: review group statement or virtual meeting, errors found, conference announcement

open_claims.claim: Local smoothing, Kakeya and Stein restriction in all dimensions (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Lean proof per OpenAI; no outside expert verdict found as of 2026-11-23
open_claims.watch: harmonic analysts' comments (Guth, Wang, Zahl, Tao), whether formal statement matches the conjecture

open_claims.claim: Existence of QCD and pure Yang-Mills in 4D (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Lean code public since 10 Nov (github.com/yang-mills-group); committee (Gross chair) assessment: Wightman theory exists as scaling limit of 4D Wilson lattice theory for any simple compact group; no uniqueness of infinite-volume limit, no mass gap, QCD not addressed; 1,147-page proof unreleased; Armstrong urges open review; further submissions (OpenAI 4 Nov, Alpoge-Sussman 15 Nov) listed as work in progress
open_claims.watch: outside audit of Lean Wightman definitions, natural-language proof release, QCD materials, Alpoge-Sussman assessment

open_claims.claim: Quasi-Riemann hypothesis: zeta zeros in strip 1/8-7/8 (Lean) and 1/12-11/12 (informal) (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Quanta: experts largely agree 11/12 version correct; Radziwill can sketch it; Sarnak withholds 'theorem' until fully checked; private 7-13 page write-ups circulating
open_claims.watch: public human write-ups, any check of the 7/8 manuscript

open_claims.claim: Other October 6 release claims, incl. omega <= 9/4
open_claims.status: unverified individually, except Landau-Siegel and Hilbert's tenth over Q (now separate entries)
open_claims.watch: specialist verdicts on individual claims

open_claims.claim: Deterministic factoring in time N^o(1) (Rudich, Rousseau, Claude)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked 13-line statement; no human-readable proof yet; Glazer (via AI audit) says Lean matches its statement, English write-up has errors
open_claims.watch: human write-up, number theorists' review, extensions (e.g. deterministic discrete log)

open_claims.claim: Complete Lean formalization of CFSG (Axiom), with Walter UGT gap and repair
open_claims.status: kernel-checked per Axiom; no outside rebuild yet; formal-statement fidelity not yet human-reviewed; Lyons and Solomon advised on repair
open_claims.watch: independent rebuild, review of definitions, group theorists' assessment of errata

open_claims.claim: AI will weaken lattice crypto within two years (Buterin)
open_claims.status: prediction; no attack on ML-KEM/ML-DSA/unstructured LWE known; Bashiri's provable dual attack (human) explicitly does not threaten them
open_claims.watch: any AI result on standardized lattice schemes

open_claims.claim: No Landau-Siegel zeros: (1-beta) log q >= c (OpenAI, Oct 6 release)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked (statement fidelity not audited); independently reworked and simplified by Green, Kerr, Banks (explicit constants), Barreto (3 pages); Granville: 'It's all moot now'; no peer review yet
open_claims.watch: peer-reviewed version, audit of Lean statement

open_claims.claim: Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture: influence >= c Var^{5/2}/d^6 (PSI, non-public Anthropic model)
open_claims.status: Lean-checked (standard axioms, lean4lean second check); Aaronson believes it correct (blog, 8 Nov); PSI says Stanford group (Blanc, Docter, Strassle, Tan) reviewed it, not confirmed by them directly; as of 2026-11-16 PSI says Stanford group sent comments and is writing exposition; nothing from the group directly; nothing from the group directly as of 2026-11-23
open_claims.watch: Stanford exposition, audit of PrintedConjecture statement, peer review

open_claims.claim: DeepMind: ~1,600x cheaper affine-root RSA-1024 forgery (theoretical), ~30x cheaper batch factoring per key
open_claims.status: company claim in unreviewed working papers; only measured gain 3.5x on rerun of ePrint 2026/2131 computation; no Fan Factories implementation
open_claims.watch: papers on ePrint/peer review, implementation, cryptographers' assessment

open_claims.claim: No bound helium dianion (Shelley-Tartakovsky, with Claude)
open_claims.status: interval-arithmetic certificate on Zenodo; not rerun by outsiders; no Lean
open_claims.watch: independent rerun of certificate, extensions (He-, lithium)

open_claims.claim: Mezard-Parisi formula for random K-SAT / diluted even p-spin (Panchenko via ChatGPT Astra; separate OpenAI proof)
open_claims.status: preprint, human-checked by author; no outside review found
open_claims.watch: specialist reaction, comparison with OpenAI's proof

open_claims.claim: Hilbert's tenth problem over Q is undecidable; Z is Diophantine in Q (OpenAI manuscript; Glazer et al.; Burungale; Sun; Kozachinskiy-Pasten-Vidaux conditional)
open_claims.status: OpenAI 62-page manuscript unformalized and unreviewed; Glazer et al. polynomial down to 196 variables, degree 4, Lean incomplete (sorry), AI-audited only; Sun 26 unknowns (16 under abc) improving on Conant et al.; Burungale independent unconditional proof avoiding OpenAI's new inputs (12 Nov); no specialist verdict as of 2026-11-23
open_claims.watch: expert assessment of Burungale's proof, Lean completion, peer review; consequences (Mazur's conjecture false)

open_claims.claim: Anthropic FLT reproof in 28.7 h by 1,000 agents; Axiom Faltings (Bombieri-Vojta) and Weil conjectures in Lean
open_claims.status: kernel-checked per companies; no outside rebuild; statement audits not reported (Axiom)
open_claims.watch: independent rebuilds, statement fidelity review

open_claims.claim: Ternary Goldbach in Lean (calr3 repo)
open_claims.status: sorry-free, standard axioms, conditional on Platt GRH computation and binary Goldbach to 4e18; Comparator not rerun on current version
open_claims.watch: Comparator run, discharge of numerical hypotheses

open_claims.claim: Lean-verified quantum programs, up to 290x cheaper arcsin and ~11x/8x/2.5x simulations (DeepMind)
open_claims.status: preprint; library not yet open-sourced; logical costs only; baselines chosen by authors
open_claims.watch: code release, application to Shor arithmetic

open_claims.claim: 39-step SHA-256 collisions below birthday bound (Gong et al.)
open_claims.status: preprint, cost estimates only, no collision computed
open_claims.watch: implementation, cryptanalysts' assessment

open_claims.claim: Max nonlinearity of balanced 10-variable Boolean functions is 492 (Xu, Wang)
open_claims.status: preprint, no outside review
open_claims.watch: expert check, formal verification

open_claims.claim: Riemann hypothesis and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions (Alpöge with Claude, 20 Nov)
open_claims.status: ~17M-line Lean proof of Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis plus Dirichlet GRH, standard axioms only; accepted by Lean kernel, nanoda, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron, comparator (Sutherland log); Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative joint statement of full confidence (21 Nov); no human-readable proof; Rubinstein-directed AI-written exposition reduces zeta case to inequality (M), not yet proved there; Maynard (to Nature): historic if it checks out; Granville: release 'garbled'; no peer review
open_claims.watch: human proof of (M), simplifications, extension to Hecke/automorphic L-functions, number theorists' verdicts, Alpöge write-up

open_claims.claim: GRH for Hecke L-functions (Masullo, human, 940-page draft)
open_claims.status: posted 20 Nov via Vakil; Conrad: undergoing major revision; final chapter has placeholders; possible gaps reported (Naslund, Markushevich-basis issue)
open_claims.watch: revised manuscript, Conrad assessment

open_claims.claim: Quasipolynomial quantum algorithm for vector DCP with smooth modulus (Gupte, GPT-5.6 Sol)
open_claims.status: preprint; author states no new attack on LWE; concurrent Boucher-Fouque-Shen for prime powers
open_claims.watch: expert review, any improvement to LWE-to-EDCP sample count

open_claims.claim: AlphaProof Code: libsignal machine code satisfies forward secrecy, PCS, authentication (DeepMind)
open_claims.status: company technical report; Lean artifacts public; ~26k trusted lines (specs, AArch64 semantics); no outside audit reported
open_claims.watch: independent rebuild, audit of specifications and ISA model

open_claims.claim: Candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model (Craig with GPT-6 Astra)
open_claims.status: preprint; reviewed with questions by Golterman, Kronfeld, Shamir, no endorsement stated; reflection positivity open; no Lean
open_claims.watch: lattice theorists' verdict, reflection positivity
